R2-1: closed — every wait in every policy can be met in every reachable world: relief waits name the relief owed "if any" (action form), each relief and credit states and computes when it is not owed (no fee, fee already waived or paid, courtesy count where it applies, priority, a 0.00 result), fee waits cover only the record the fee policy prices and exempt a fee at 0.00, early-closure reliefs are not limited by the courtesy count and the request-less reliefs are not held to the request window (declared overwrites), and every write policy states its 0.00 outcome.
R2-2: closed — priority sentences give a fee of an account with a pending early-closure request to the early-closure relief; the made-good relief and the goodwill credit are not granted then, and compute returns nothing for them.
R2-3: closed — the waits whose waiver row two writes can leave are action form naming the relief, with the fallback reason recorded; the remaining state-form waits each have a single writer.
R2-4: closed — the add-back is gone; the paid-part tiers cover every past-due case; a request before the return counts no days and earns no promptness addition; the chargeback test reads the chargeback of that payment; fee, relief and credit computes now apply every exclusion their rules state.
R2-5: closed — each shared record selection is one plain binding; reason and timing factors read their own evidence keyed by it; no factor reads another factor.
R2-6: closed — the clearing add-back and its factor are struck; the settlement's fourth factor is a payment-record share on closing interest.
T1-rounding: closed — every money rule states half-cent-up rounding and compute rounds in exact decimal at those points; task 1's world no longer lands its fee on a half cent, and no gold value of either task does.
